detail.addHint: Added courses are delivered to everyone who currently holds the pass, expiring with their plan.
detail.allCoursesHint: This pass follows your catalogue: courses you publish are added automatically (on the next sync). To pick courses by hand, edit the pass and switch to selected courses.
detail.catalogueHint: To show passes on your website, add the "Access Passes" section in Manage Pages.
detail.coursesAdded: Courses added. Current holders get them within a few minutes.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this pass? Current holders keep their access until their plan ends.
detail.noHolders: Nobody has bought this pass yet
detail.notSelling: The link only accepts purchases while the pass is published.
detail.removeConfirmKeep: Remove this course? New buyers will not get it; current holders keep it until their plan ends.
detail.removeConfirmRevoke: Remove this course? Current holders will LOSE access to it.
detail.syncDone: Synced {{plans}} holders: {{granted}} courses granted, {{revoked}} revoked, {{failed}} failed
detail.syncDoneB2B: Synced {{subOrgs}} sub-orgs: {{linked}} courses newly linked, {{failed}} failed
detail.syncPending: Course changes are still being applied to current holders.
detail.syncRunning: A sync is already running for this pass

editor.name: Name
editor.paymentRequired: Choose how the pass is priced
editor.policy: When a course is removed from the pass
editor.policyKeep: Current holders keep it until their plan ends
editor.policyRevoke: Remove it from current holders too
editor.repriceHint: Changing this re-prices the pass for new buyers only. Current holders keep their plan.
editor.scopeAllHint: Every live course of the institute is included. Courses you publish later are added to the pass, and to everyone holding it, automatically.

empty.body: Create a pass, pick the courses it unlocks and how it is priced, then publish it.
empty.title: No access passes yet

intro: Sell several courses as one purchase. Courses you add later are delivered to everyone who already holds the pass.

pricing.cpoNotHere: Create fee plans in Financial Management, then pick them from the pricing list.

subOrgs.assigned: Pass assigned. Its courses are now linked to the sub-org.
subOrgs.hint: The sub-org must already exist (Manage Sub-Orgs). Assigning links the pass’s courses to it, mirrors its learner links and gives its team access. Courses added to the pass later are pushed to every assigned sub-org.
subOrgs.none: Not assigned to any sub-org yet
subOrgs.title: Sub-organisations holding this pass
subOrgs.unassignConfirm: Stop syncing this pass to the sub-org? Courses already linked stay with it.
subOrgs.unassigned: Sub-org will no longer receive this pass’s new courses
